candidates.label: Language, cognition & communication
candidates.finding: UCR offers genuine psycholinguistics, stylistics, rhetorical communication and text-related computing. The proposed programmes place most credits in broader cognition, media, communication or general computing and mathematics. They do not sustain the cumulative phonetic, phonological, morphological, syntactic, semantic, sociolinguistic and language-research study that defines this Linguistics degree. A broad coherent programme and a small number of direct language courses cannot establish a sufficiently close complete response. This finding concerns academic substance, not identical courses or professional equivalence.
candidates.conclusion: Fails programme-level academic response before schedule feasibility; earlier not-feasible label is diagnostic academic shortfall, not missing offerings.

candidates.label: Data, AI & language applications
candidates.finding: 127.5 EC general computing/AI/mathematics and only15 EC psycholinguistics/stylistics, plus partial text/LLM applications, do not sustain computational-linguistics or a sufficiently close programme-level linguistic response.
candidates.conclusion: Fails programme-level academic response before schedule feasibility; earlier not-feasible label is diagnostic academic shortfall, not missing offerings.

candidates.label: Language and health
candidates.finding: Psycholinguistics includes impairment but no sustained speech/voice/hearing, language-disorder assessment/intervention or language-development sequence. Generic neuroscience/development is insufficient.
candidates.conclusion: Fails programme-level academic response before schedule feasibility; earlier not-feasible label is diagnostic academic shortfall, not missing offerings.

candidates.label: Multilingualism and society
candidates.finding: Sociology and communication are meaningful context but no sustained sociolinguistics, multilingualism and language-variation sequence exists in actual workbook. No manufactured third route.
candidates.conclusion: Fails programme-level academic response before schedule feasibility; earlier not-feasible label is diagnostic academic shortfall, not missing offerings.

strongestAttempt: Tested integrated language/cognition/communication response with psycholinguistics and stylistics as direct core, rhetoric/creative and literary language, brain/behaviour, developmental and social psychology, methods/statistics, text data/deep learning and sociology. These are coherent interdisciplinary possibilities. Their defining weight remains cognition, communication or general computing rather than sustained inquiry into language structure, variation/acquisition and cumulative linguistic research. Concentrating the strongest language courses does not cure this by adding generic electives. No disciplinary-equivalence quota is used; missing degree title, professional licence and course offerings do not decide the result.
stopping: Closest response fails substantive comparability. Computational language, language/health and multilingual/society considered as diagnostic challenges, not skipped alternative slots. None adds an evidenced sustained language-science route. Stop without exporting a weak24-course comparison.
